name: Suzhou Novosense Microlectronics
summary: Suzhou Novosense Microelectronics Co., Ltd. is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to the research, development, design, and commercialization of analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits. The firm supplies a comprehensive array of specialized components, including various isolated and non-isolated drivers (such as half-bridge, single-channel, smart, automotive exterior LED, brushed DC motor, relay, and solenoid drivers), communication transceivers (like CAN/LIN and 485), diverse interfaces (I2C, LVDS/MLVDS, digital isolators, and other isolated interfaces), power management solutions (including isolated power products and low dropout regulators), and a wide selection of sensors (current, magnetic position, pressure, temperature/humidity, alongside sensor signal conditioning chips) and smart switches (high/low side). These advanced microelectronic solutions are deployed across numerous sectors, such as the automotive, industrial, information communication, and consumer electronics industries. Established in 2013, the company operates from its main office located in Suzhou, China.
